title: Fix some more wrong filter names.
description:
These are duplicates detected seen by running
check_typed_item_calls.py  --consecutive.

There are still quite a few more to go.

notes.body: enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 8b4e0148a231658ed7b420a4e98ffea9d6306a5e succeeds
Sorry Pascal, didn't realise you were trying out ws-gitlab-utility...
